name: vscode-markdown-workbench
description: Plugin-based Markdown Live Preview for VS Code.

commands.title: Use Markdown Workshop for Markdown in This Workspace
Open Marp Preview to the Side

markdownWorkshop.plugins.agentBridge.ena.description: Copy selected text with a link to its saved source lines, for an agent.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.assets.enabled.description: Import a file into the project's assets folder and insert a portable Markdown link.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.autoPair.enable.description: Auto pair in the Markdown editor.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.backlinks.enabl.description: Backlinks view and status bar count for the active note, with unlinked mentions.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.bridge.enabled.description: Build a versioned selection envelope for an agent. Agent PDF Viewer is used when it is installed. This does not open a chat.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.callouts.enable.description: Render callouts and remember their disclosure state per panel.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.codeBlocks.enab.description: Highlight rendered and editable code fences; copy code.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.cursorBridge.en.description: In Cursor, Cmd/Ctrl+L opens Chat and Cmd/Ctrl+K opens Edit on the Live Preview selection.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.diagrams.enable.description: Render Mermaid diagrams in strict mode.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.embeds.enabled.description: Transclude notes, images and media; open attachment cards.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.footnotes.enabl.description: Footnote references, definitions, previews and navigation.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.gitDiffEditor.e.description: A side-by-side diff of two versions of a note, both rendered, blocks aligned and changed words marked. Opens from Source Control when diffEditor is rendered.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.gitGutter.enabl.description: Added, modified and deleted bars beside the line numbers, like VS Code's quick diff, with a raw unified peek to revert a hunk.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.gitInline.enabl.description: Track changes in the rendered note: removed words struck through, added words tinted, removed blocks shown with Restore. Needs Git change bars.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.graph.enabled.description: Draw an OKF bundle as a directed graph of notes, in a panel of its own.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.indentGuides.en.description: Indentation guides in the Markdown editor.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.inlineTitle.ena.description: Show and rename the note title above its Markdown content.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.lineNumbers.ena.description: Line numbers in the Markdown editor, laid out like VS Code's text editor and following editor.lineNumbers.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.linkUpdates.ena.description: Update links in other notes when a note or attachment is renamed or moved in VS Code.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.marp.enabled.description: Detect Marp decks and open Marp's preview or export. Decks inside a wiki bundle are not wrapped into pages.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.obsidianCompat..description: Use Obsidian property types and vault settings in Markdown Workshop.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.okfCore.enabled.description: Shared Open Knowledge Format bundles, link resolution and resource checks.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.onlineVideos.en.description: Show YouTube and Bilibili links embedded as images as video cards, with titles and covers in trusted workspaces.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.outgoingLinks.e.description: Outgoing links view: the notes and files the active note links to, and links not created yet.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.outline.enabled.description: Note Outline with expansion actions and optional cursor following. Go to Heading (Ctrl+Shift+O) searches the active Workbench note's headings.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.pagePreview.ena.description: Preview internal links with a modifier hover or keyboard.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.pasteHtml.enabl.description: Convert rich clipboard HTML into Markdown in notes and table cells.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.properties.enab.description: Edit YAML properties as typed fields, lists and ordered rows.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.quickSwitcher.e.description: Find a note by name, alias or path, or create it, like Obsidian's quick switcher.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.scratch.enabled.description: Temporary notes outside the wiki bundle. Promote one into the wiki only when you ask.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.search.enabled.description: Render query blocks as live vault search results.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.smartLists.enab.description: Smart lists in the Markdown editor.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.sourcesProperty.description: Show OKF sources with open links; values edit as YAML beside other Properties.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.suggest.enabled.description: Complete links, headings, blocks and tags from the vault index.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.tables.enabled.description: Edit Markdown tables as grids with projected cell editing.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.tags.enabled.description: Render tags, find notes with matching hierarchical tags, and list the vault's tags in the Tags view.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.wiki.enabled.description: Read a project's .wiki layout and copy a reference for an agent. This does not run an agent or create folders.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.wordCount.enabl.description: Word and character count of the active note, or of the selection, in the status bar.

markdownWorkshop.assets.path.description: Project-relative assets folder used when the folder has no .wiki/layout.json. Empty uses assets. The folder is created on import, not on open.

markdownWorkshop.editor.fontSize.description: Font size of the note text in pixels (Obsidian's default is 16). Headings, code, tables, line numbers, properties and footnotes scale with it. It replaces editor.fontSize for notes; the font family still follows editor.fontFamily.

markdownWorkshop.editor.lineHeight.description: Line height of the note text as a multiple of its font size (Obsidian's default is 1.5). It replaces editor.lineHeight for notes.

markdownWorkshop.gitDiffEditor.diffEdito.description: How a Markdown diff opened from Source Control or the Timeline is shown: VS Code's text diff (native), or both versions rendered side by side (rendered).

markdownWorkshop.gitGutter.compareTo.description: What the change bars compare the note with: the last commit (HEAD) or the staged version (index).

markdownWorkshop.graph.maxNodes.description: Hard cap on notes drawn in the vault graph.

markdownWorkshop.graph.maxEdges.description: Hard cap on aggregated links drawn in the vault graph.

markdownWorkshop.graph.defaultMode.description: Open the vault graph in global or local mode.

markdownWorkshop.graph.localDepth.description: How many hops the local graph includes.

markdownWorkshop.graph.colorBy.description: Color graph notes by type, folder or first tag.

markdownWorkshop.linkUpdates.mode.description: Obsidian's Automatically update internal links: `prompt` asks before rewriting links in other notes when a file is renamed or moved.

markdownWorkshop.files.newNoteFolder.description: New notes: empty for vault root, . for current folder, or a vault-relative path.

markdownWorkshop.files.attachmentFolder.description: Attachment destination policy: empty for vault root, . for current folder, or ./sub. Rich HTML paste keeps links and does not import files.

markdownWorkshop.marp.open.description: Where a Marp deck opens. textEditor sends it to VS Code's text editor, where Marp's own preview and export run. Keep in Workshop remembers a deck.

markdownWorkshop.obsidianCompat.configFo.description: Obsidian configuration folder relative to the vault root, such as .obsidian-awesome. Root markers discover the vault; they do not select this folder.

markdownWorkshop.okfCore.bundles.description: Extra OKF bundle roots, relative to the vault. A folder is also a bundle when it contains index.md and a typed concept.

markdownWorkshop.onlineVideos.bilibiliPl.description: Offer **Play here** on Bilibili cards in trusted workspaces. Off by default: Bilibili's player does not play inside VS Code's webview.

markdownWorkshop.outline.followCursor.description: Select and reveal the current heading in Note Outline as the cursor moves, without taking focus.

markdownWorkshop.scratch.folder.description: Project-relative folder for scratch notes when the folder has no .wiki/layout.json. A loaded layout uses its scratch path. The folder is created when you create a note.

markdownWorkshop.tags.viewSort.description: Order of the Tags view: `name` (A to Z) or `frequency` (most notes first).

markdownWorkshop.tags.viewNested.description: Show nested tags (`#a/b`) under their parent in the Tags view, rather than as a flat list.

markdownWorkshop.vault.rootMarkers.description: A folder containing one of these entries is a vault root; without one, the workspace folder is the vault.

markdownWorkshop.vault.excludedFiles.description: Obsidian's Excluded files: path prefixes such as `Archive/`, or globs such as `**/*.excalidraw.md`. Excluded files stay linkable but are left out of the quick switcher, suggestions, search and unlinked mentions.

enumDescriptions: The editor's own chat (Cursor, or VS Code with a chat extension such as Copilot Chat) when it is the only agent installed; with Claude Code or Codex installed too, only copy, to paste into the agent you use.
Cursor's agent chat, with the passage on the clipboard to paste.
VS Code's chat, with the passage typed in.
Claude Code: a new conversation with the passage typed in.
Codex: the passage attached to the thread as a file.
markdownWorkshop.copyLinkForAgent.target.markdownDescription: Which chat **Copy Link for Agent** opens after copying the link and passage. Extensions cannot see which agent you are working in, so `auto` only opens a chat when the editor's own chat is the only agent; pick one here to send the passage to it.

markdownWorkshop.debug.logging.description: Log plugin load/stop timings and debug messages in the Markdown Workshop output channel.

markdownWorkshop.plugins.external.description: External host plugin enablement by registered plugin ID.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Remote content and external code processors are disabled.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p src/host && tsc -p src/webview && tsc -p src/plugins/tsconfig.host.json && tsc -p src/plugins/tsconfig.webview.json && tsc -p src/workers && tsc -p test
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm contributions --check
scripts.check:full: pnpm check && pnpm test:browser && pnpm test:vscode
scripts.package: pnpm build && node scripts/third-party-notices.mjs --check && vsce package --no-dependencies --no-rewrite-relative-links
